```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Azimuth)
library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here); i_am("analysis/progenitors/progenitors_annotate_w_miranda.Rmd")
```

```{r}
subset_data =  T
miranda_data = "/home/sarahhp/home/sc_rnaseq/other_data/miranda2025"
module = "adipogenesis"
qdataname = "initial_r2_only"
odir = here("output", module,qdataname)
```

## load reference dataset

```{r}
atissue = readRDS(here(miranda_data,"global_integrated_scp_bpcells.rds"))
Idents(atissue) = "cell_type_level2"
table(Idents(atissue))
```


```{r}
ref = subset(atissue, idents=c("ASC","APC","Adipocytes"))
table(ref$cell_state,ref$cell_type_level2, useNA = "ifany")
Idents(ref) = "cell_state"
if (subset_data){
  ref = subset(ref, downsample=1000)
} 
table(ref$cell_state, useNA = "ifany")
rm(atissue)
```

```{r}
ref
# remove Emont cells with NA.  To do: substitute them 
sig_mat = LayerData(ref, layer="counts")
cells_with_nans <- apply(sig_mat, 2, function(x) any(is.nan(x)))
ref = subset(ref, cells=colnames(ref)[!cells_with_nans])
ref
```


```{r themes}
pal = c("#1F78B4", "#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
clusters = ggsci::pal_simpsons()(13)[c(1:7,9:14)]
  #tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"))
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.25)))
```

## Create azimuth reference

preprocessing
```{r}
refso = SCTransform(ref)
refso = RunPCA(refso, verbose = F)
refso <- FindNeighbors(refso, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
refso = RunUMAP(refso, dims=1:20, return.model = T, verbose=F, n.neighbors = 20)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(refso, group.by = "cell_state")  + scale_color_manual(values = clusters)
```

```{r}
azdir = file.path(miranda_data, "azimuth_reference")
if (!dir.exists(azdir)){dir.create(azdir, recursive = T)}

refdata <- AzimuthReference(refso,
    # Specify features to include as required
    refDR="pca",
    metadata = c("cell_state","donor_id")
)
```


```{r}
if (subset_data == F){
  saveRDS(refdata, file.path(azdir, "ref.Rds"))
  SaveAnnoyIndex(object = refdata[["refdr.annoy.neighbors"]], file = file.path(azdir, "idx.annoy"))
} else if (subset_data){
  azdir = file.path(azdir, "10%_subset")
  if (!dir.exists(azdir)){dir.create(azdir, recursive = T)}
  saveRDS(refdata, file.path(azdir, "ref.Rds"))
  SaveAnnoyIndex(object = refdata[["refdr.annoy.neighbors"]], file = file.path(azdir, "idx.annoy"))
}

```


```{r}
DimPlot(refdata)  + scale_color_manual(values = clusters)
DimPlot(refdata, group.by = "cell_state")  + scale_color_manual(values = clusters)
```
## Load Query Datasets

```{r}
if (subset_data){
  qso = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  qso = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
}
qso
```

```{r}
DimPlot(qso) + scale_colour_manual(values = clusters)
DimPlot(qso, group.by = time) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal)
```

## Map clusters

Not many anchors found for mapping :/ so we're adding a kweight limit to the Run Azimuth code aka. 
trace("RunAzimuth.Seurat", where=asNamespace("Azimuth"), edit=T)
adding kanchors=k.weight as a param to MappingScore on ln 107

```{r}
annot <- RunAzimuth(
    query = qso,
    reference = azdir, k.weight=45)
```

```{r}
colnames(annot@meta.data)
DimPlot(annot, group.by = "predicted.cell_state", shuffle = T)
```
```{r}
DimPlot(annot, group.by = "predicted.cell_state.score", shuffle = T)
```


```{r save}
if (subset_data == FALSE){
  saveRDS(annot, file = here(odir, "complete_analysis.annot.rds"))
  sub = subset(annot, downsample=1000)
  saveRDS(sub,here(odir,"10%_complete_analysis.annot.rds"))
} else if (subset_data){ #if subset, don't save complete analysis
  saveRDS(annot,here(odir, "10%_subset_analysis.annot.rds"))
}
```
